Dialogs show on top again.

- In 0.8.4, a dialog opened from the sidebar (New session, Quick
  Connect, Connect, Edit, Import, the file explorer's) opened under the
  terminal or the start screen, where it could be neither seen nor
  clicked. Fixed. Reported by @AliceT8d and @ZZZank.
